The autonomous relay DDE has |g(t)|<=1+norm(phi) for all t>=0, so eta=q/2 satisfies every strict invisibility condition globally. All nested trajectories coincide with g. On a genuine initial interval, chain differentiation yields D_i=1-sum_{k=1}^{i-1}q^k, a plateau at equality and reversal above. Source Theorem 5.1 proves strict TOR below nu_i. Python rational script passed 345 corroborative checks; it is not used in place of an infinite proof.
